raw_meta_yaml:
schema_version: 1

context:
  name: custodian
  version: 2025.12.14

package:
  name: ${{ name|lower }}
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  url: https://github.com/materialsproject/custodian/archive/v${{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: 04e948a57d8df9fc8394df3c827b71cf76c3c7648fe308ab1ef2847344160c75

build:
  number: 1
  noarch: python
  script: ${{ PYTHON }} -m pip install . -vv --no-deps --no-build-isolation
  python:
    entry_points:
      - cstdn = custodian.cli.cstdn:main
      - run_vasp = custodian.cli.run_vasp:main
      - run_nwchem = custodian.cli.run_nwchem:main
      - converge_kpoints = custodian.cli.converge_kpoints:main
      - converge_geometry = custodian.cli.converge_geometry:main

requirements:
  host:
    - python ${{ python_min }}.*
    - pip
    - setuptools
  run:
    - python >=${{ python_min }}
    - monty >=2.0.6
    - ruamel.yaml >=0.15.6
    - sentry-sdk >=0.8.0
    - psutil

tests:
  - python:
      imports:
        - custodian
      pip_check: true
      python_version: ${{ python_min }}.*
  - requirements:
      run:
        - pip
        - pymatgen
        - python ${{ python_min }}.*
    script:
      - cstdn --help
      - run_vasp --help
      - run_nwchem --help
      - converge_kpoints --help

about:
  summary: A simple JIT job management framework in Python.
  license: MIT
  license_file: LICENSE
  homepage: https://github.com/materialsproject/custodian
  documentation: https://pythonhosted.org/custodian/

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - shyuep
    - mkhorton
    - jan-janssen
